## Monitor Competitor 1-Star Shopify App Reviews for Churn Lead Generation
**Powered by StoreIntel Labs on Apify:** [Shopify App Store Scraper: Apps, Pricing, Developer Leads & 1-Star Reviews](https://apify.com/storeintel/shopify-app-store-scraper)

Track newly posted 1-star and 2-star reviews on competing Shopify apps every morning, extract the frustrated merchant's store name, country, and time spent using the app, and alert your sales team in Slack/HubSpot.

### Quick Setup (30 seconds)
1. Get your free Apify API token at `https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations`.
2. Open the **Run StoreIntel Apify Actor** node and paste your token in the `Authorization` header (`Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`).
3. Customize the JSON input body or connect it to your Google Sheet / Webhook trigger.

### Pre-Configured Apify Task Templates
- [Shopify App 1-Star Reviews & Competitor Churn Leads Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/shopify-app-1-star-churn-leads-scraper)
- [Shopify App Developer Emails, Pricing Plans & SaaS Leads Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/shopify-app-developer-email-pricing-scraper)
- [Shopify App Store Category Ranking & Keyword Discovery Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/shopify-category-competitor-ranking-scraper)
